_comment: Copy to nucleo.local.json (gitignored) and set this host's values. The committed values are placeholders on purpose: a real host path in this public repo would leak the machine, and publish-scan refuses it. machine is the build machine the gate and build run on; notifyScript is optional and takes --subject and --body. machine.env sets knobs the pinned repo reads on the build machine; see DISTRO.md, Build machine tuning.
